items.quote: What is the mean number of cases recorded across all countries and years?
items.description: 計算 'No. of cases' 欄所有國家與年份的均值，須與 answer.txt 中 @mean_cases 值一致。

items.quote: Ignore those records where 'No. of cases' column value is Null or empty.
items.description: 重算均值時須忽略 'No. of cases' 為 Null 或空白的紀錄（mean_int_col 內建忽略 Null/空白）。
answer.txt 須含 @mean_cases[...] 項目，值為正整數。

items.quote: Put each answer item on its own line, in the form `@name[value]`, using exactly the names given under "Answer format" in the task.
items.description: answer.txt 中答案項須為 @mean_cases[value] 格式，各佔一行。

items.quote: Convert the data type of 'No. of cases' column from Object (string) to Int64 before performing calculations.
items.description: 計算前須將 'No. of cases' 由字串轉為整數；mean_int_col 以整數儲存格口徑重算均值並四捨五入為整數。
